needs_atom.missing: Mana-spend restriction with an activation use: 'Spend this mana only to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts.' MANA_POLICY scope=THIS_MANA has one filter, read over the spell being cast (legality._mana_use_ok); it has no use-kind axis to also allow activating abilities whose source is an artifact, and the engine never lets THIS_MANA-tagged mana pay an activation cost. A filter of TYPE_EQ Artifact alone would mean 'only to cast artifact spells' (dropping the activation use). Needed: a MANA_POLICY use axis (cast spell / activate ability of a source) or equivalent. The {T}: Add {C}{C} ability (compiled) and the {U},{T} named-card tutor (SEARCH with FOr of NAME_EQ, REVEAL, SHUFFLE, as Fierce Empath) are expressible.
